# Definition 
**Uterine Sarcoma** is a rare aggressive malignancy of uterine tissue. 

# Risk Factors 
- tamoxifen use 
- pelvic radiation 

# Presentation 
- Uterine mass (irregularly shaped uterus)
- bulk symptoms (pelvic pressure, constipation)
- postmenopausal bleed 
*looks like fibroids; has tamoxifen $\pm$ radiation as risk factors*
